_comment: Machine-readable manifest consumed by rag/ingest.py. Human-readable summary is sources.md — keep both in sync. extraction_hint is advisory only; ingest.py always re-verifies per-page via the Bangla-Unicode-ratio heuristic and falls back to OCR automatically, so a wrong hint here cannot silently corrupt a chunk.

documents.title: কৃষি প্রযুক্তি হাতবই (৬ষ্ঠ সংস্করণ)
documents.source_url: bari.gov.bd (manually downloaded by user)
documents.notes: 650-page multi-crop handbook using a non-Unicode legacy Bangla font (PyMuPDF text layer is garbled ASCII soup, Bangla-Unicode ratio ~0.0). Full-book OCR at ~2.8s/page would take ~30 min and mostly OCR irrelevant chapters (fruit, flower, spice, machinery, etc.). Scoped to relevant chapters only via the PDF's own bookmarks/TOC (which are in readable transliterated English, unaffected by the font issue).
documents.page_range_rationale: Derived from doc.get_toc() bookmarks. Full handbook TOC preserved above the table in sources.md for future re-scoping if a later phase needs other chapters (e.g. IPM_521-538, Irrigation_504-520).
